title: Neptune Apex Reading Probe Value Leaderboard
dataSources: Reef-tank parameters (`reeftank:param`), vivarium climate (`vivarium:climate`), fish feeder (`fishfeeder:event`), auto-doser (`doser:event`), auto-top-off (`ato:event`), pond sensors (`pondsensor:reading`).
app: Aquarium and vivarium controllers — reef-tank parameter monitors, auto-dosers, auto-top-off, reptile terrarium climate/UVB, and pond sensors — via MQTT and controller APIs (Apex, GHL, ESPHome).
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=neptune:apex value_num=*
| stats sum(value_num) as total_value, avg(value_num) as avg_value by probe_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks probe values by total and average probe value across Neptune Apex reading events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `value_num` values for each Neptune Apex reading event and review total and average probe value by probe.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total probe value.
grandmaExplanation: It finds which probe shows the biggest probe value numbers in your Neptune Apex reading data.
